comparison.objective: Tune and lock a damper versus remove a slip-sheet without displacing its load.
comparison.physical_skill: Fine tool use and adjustment under torque constraints versus coordinated pulling and load bracing against friction.
comparison.success_condition: Two non-bottoming stops and no setting drift versus sheet fully removed while block motion and tilt remain below limits.
comparison.reason: Generic counterholding is shared, but the controlled interaction and measured outcome are different.
